publication_limits: Only published client-facing callable ABI signatures are bound; unpublished contract storage layouts, admin interfaces and private settlement instructions are not inferred.
AsyncAPI perps schema/example discrepancies are explicitly normalized in stream-notes-perps.json.
RTDS retains documented legacy channels and native payload values; SDK display normalization is not applied.

GET /auth/api-keys is L1 in the pinned OpenAPI and L2 in the pinned SDK. The named interface selects L2 when API credentials are configured and otherwise L1; it does not retry with a different authority. DELETE /auth/api-key uses L2 as specified by both sources.
